_metadata.description: Commercial and non-commercial model lanes are separable by configuration, not by convention.

requirements.title: Lane is a first-class registry property
requirements.description: Every model declares whether it is usable in a commercially distributed build. Several of the strongest analysis models are non-commercial, and at least one supporting tool declares no licence at all; the lane must be recorded per model rather than assumed per scenario.

validation.notes: Licence-lane isolation is later-scope work outside this composition slice

requirements.title: Permissive builds are provably clean
requirements.description: A build configured for the permissive lane refuses to resolve any restricted-lane model, and still satisfies the composition and analysis contracts using permissive models only.

validation.notes: Licence-lane isolation is later-scope work outside this composition slice

requirements.title: Copyleft tools are process-isolated
requirements.description: Tools under copyleft licences are invoked as separate processes and never linked in-process, so their obligations do not propagate to the scenario binary.

validation.notes: Licence-lane isolation is later-scope work outside this composition slice
